mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_NO, USER_ID, TYPE, MESSAGE, LINK_URL, IS_READ, TO_CHAR(CDATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CDATETIME FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CDATETIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE CDATETIME < SYSDATE - 30
